title: Pure Rokket
summary: Rokket and Borrel cards with the generic DARK Dragon Links and Fusion Spells built for them, plus generic staples. The page's combo lines add Red-Eyes, Metalmorph, Bystial and Dragunity cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Rokket Barrage, Borreload Liberator Dragon and Triple Borrel Launch aren't out in the TCG until 12 November 2026. Breachborrel Dragon, the newest card, searches a Borrel Spell/Trap and brings a Rokket from the Deck when its target leaves the field. Rokket Loader searches the Level 7s, and almost every Rokket locks the Extra Deck to DARK, so the whole Extra Deck is DARK Dragons.

exclude.Rokket Barrage: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.
exclude.Borreload Liberator Dragon: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.
exclude.Triple Borrel Launch: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.

main: Rokket Loader
2026 support. Summoned: searches a Level 7 DARK Dragon; from the GY, makes a monster DARK.
Rokket Tracer
Quick Effect: destroys a card you control to summon a Rokket from the Deck.
Absorouter Dragon
Summons itself next to a Rokket; sent to the GY, searches a Rokket monster.
Rokket Detonator
2026 support. Summons itself next to a DARK Dragon Link and revives a DARK Dragon equipped as a card.
Hollowrokket Dragon
2026 support. Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to banish from the top of their Deck; summons a Rokket at the End Phase.
Silverrokket Dragon
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to banish a card from their Extra Deck; summons a Rokket at the End Phase.
Magnarokket Dragon
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to send a monster to the GY; summons a Rokket at the End Phase.
Noctovision Dragon
Summons itself when a DARK Dragon arrives; draws as Link Material.
Rokket Caliber
Summons itself where a DARK Link points; Tributes itself to summon a DARK Dragon from the hand.
Quick Launch
Quick-Play: summons a Rokket from the Deck.
Boot Sector Launch
Field Spell that Striker Dragon searches: summons two Rokkets from the hand or GY.
Double Interlock
2026 Trisborrel search: Fusion Summons from the GY, banishing a Rokket as material.
Rapid Trigger
Quick-Play Fusion by destroying your own DARK Dragons, triggering the Rokkets.
Borrel Reboot
2026 support. Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap and Sets it on their field.
extra: Newest support. Link-2: searches a Borrel Spell/Trap and summons a Rokket from the Deck.
2026 support. Link-3: searches Double Interlock or Rapid Trigger and recycles a DARK Dragon.
2026 support. Link-5: destroys a Rokket to negate a card, and calls out another Borrel Link.
Link-5: negates a monster and revives a Rokket; unbreakable.
2026 Fusion: searches a Rokket monster; as Link Material, destroys a card.
Fusion of two DARK Dragons: destroys one of yours and one of theirs.
Link-4: shrinks a monster with no response and steals what it attacks.
Link-4: attacks twice and halves what it hits.
Link-2: destroys a monster and, if it was a Link, revives Rokkets.
Generic Link-1 for a Dragon: searches Boot Sector Launch and recycles a Rokket.
Generic Link-2 for DARK Dragons: revives itself when a Rokket arrives.
Rank 4 for two DARK Dragons: shrinks a monster and revives a Borrel.
